Name: Event_CrucifixionResurrection
EventTitle: Crucifixion, Resurrection Appearances, Ascension
DatingDisputeNote: The year of the crucifixion is disputed between AD 30 and AD 33, argued from reconstructing the Passover date against Pilate's AD 26-36 prefecture; the game does not pick a side.
DesignUse: Opening Witness Mission. Establishes the criterion of embarrassment: women as the first witnesses to the empty tomb -- a detail no one fabricating a claim in that culture would choose.

Name: Event_Pentecost
EventTitle: Pentecost; Church Formed in Jerusalem
DesignUse: Hub city established.

Name: Event_PeterJamesLeadOralPreaching
EventTitle: Peter and James the Just Lead; Apostolic Preaching Is Oral
DesignUse: Core teaching beat: the gospel existed as fixed, memorized proclamation for decades before it was written.

Name: Event_StephenMartyred
EventTitle: Stephen Martyred; Believers Scattered
DesignUse: Set piece. Introduces Saul.

Name: Event_SaulConversion
EventTitle: Saul's Conversion on the Damascus Road
DesignUse: Playable or cutscene.

Name: Event_PaulFirstJerusalemVisit
EventTitle: Paul's First Jerusalem Visit; Meets Peter and James
DesignUse: The handoff that makes Paul a link in the chain.

Name: Event_PrePaulineCreed1Cor15
EventTitle: The Pre-Pauline Creed of 1 Cor 15:3-7 Takes Fixed Form
DatingDisputeNote: Scholarly consensus dates the creed's fixed, received form very early -- plausibly within a few years of the events it summarizes -- but the exact date within the 30s-50s cannot be pinned closer than the range Paul himself implies: he received it, he did not compose it.
DesignUse: Critical mission. The earliest datable summary of the resurrection claim, received by Paul, not composed by him.

Name: Event_Cornelius
EventTitle: Cornelius; Gospel Opens to Gentiles
DesignUse: Faction unlock.

Name: Event_AntiochCongregation
EventTitle: Antioch Congregation; Disciples First Called Christianoi
DesignUse: Second hub.

Name: Event_JamesZebedeeExecuted_PeterEscapes
EventTitle: James Son of Zebedee Executed by Herod Agrippa I; Peter Imprisoned, Escapes
DesignUse: Peter leaves Jerusalem -- the thread that eventually reaches Rome and Mark.

Name: Event_FirstMissionaryJourney
EventTitle: First Missionary Journey: Paul, Barnabas, John Mark -- Mark Departs at Perga
DesignUse: Seeds the Mark/Barnabas rift and Mark's later restoration.

Name: Event_Galatians
EventTitle: Galatians Written
DatingDisputeNote: Dating is contested between an early 'South Galatian' view (~48, before the Jerusalem Council) and a later 'North Galatian' view (~55); the game presents the dispute openly rather than picking a side.
DesignUse: Present the dispute openly.

Name: Event_CouncilOfJerusalem
EventTitle: Council of Jerusalem; James Presides
DesignUse: Major dialogue/persuasion set piece.

Name: Event_SecondMissionaryJourney
EventTitle: Second Journey: Philippi, Thessalonica, Berea, Athens, Corinth

Name: Event_ThessaloniansWritten
EventTitle: 1-2 Thessalonians Written -- Earliest Surviving NT Documents
DesignUse: First physical letter the player can hold. The New Testament begins as correspondence, not as scripture.

Name: Event_GallioInscription
EventTitle: Gallio Proconsul of Achaia
DesignUse: The anchor that fixes the whole Pauline chronology to external evidence. Make this a mission -- archaeology corroborating Acts.

Name: Event_ThirdMissionaryJourney_Ephesus
EventTitle: Third Journey; Three Years at Ephesus
DesignUse: Ephesus hub; silversmiths' riot.

Name: Event_Corinthians
EventTitle: 1-2 Corinthians Written

Name: Event_RomansWritten
EventTitle: Romans Written, From Corinth

Name: Event_ArrestInJerusalem_TempleRiot
EventTitle: Arrest in Jerusalem; Temple Riot
DesignUse: Set piece.

Name: Event_CaesareaImprisonment
EventTitle: Caesarea Imprisonment; Hearings Before Felix, Festus, Agrippa II

Name: Event_VoyageToRome_MaltaShipwreck
EventTitle: Voyage to Rome; Malta Shipwreck
DesignUse: Survival set piece. Luke is present -- a 'we' passage.

Name: Event_RomanHouseArrest_PrisonEpistles
EventTitle: Roman House Arrest; Prison Epistles (Philippians, Colossians, Philemon, Ephesians)

Name: Event_JamesTheJustMartyred
EventTitle: James the Just Martyred in Jerusalem
DesignUse: Non-Christian corroboration mission.

Name: Event_MatthewComposed
EventTitle: Matthew Composes the Logia; Greek Matthew Follows
DatingDisputeNote: Resolves the Markan-priority-vs-Matthean-priority tension per Section 7: an Aramaic/Hebrew logia collection circulates early (40s-60s per Papias tradition), with the Greek Gospel of Matthew as we have it following later, after Mark. Modern source criticism holds Mark as the earliest complete narrative Gospel; patristic tradition (Papias, Irenaeus, Origen, Eusebius, Augustine) holds Matthew first. The game presents both rather than silently picking one.
DesignUse: Resolves the priority question -- see Section 7.

Name: Event_MarkWrittenInRome
EventTitle: Mark in Rome Writes Down Peter's Preaching
DatingDisputeNote: Irenaeus (Adv. Haer. 3.1.1) places composition after the exodos ('departure'/death) of Peter and Paul; Clement of Alexandria places it during Peter's lifetime, at the request of Roman hearers. The game does not silently pick one.
DesignUse: The campaign's centerpiece. Play the composition itself -- Peter dictating, Mark recording.

Name: Event_LukeActsWritten
EventTitle: Luke Writes to Theophilus After Investigating Eyewitness Sources; Acts Follows
DatingDisputeNote: Early dating (~60-62) is argued from Acts ending at Paul's house arrest, before Nero's persecution, James's death, and the AD 70 destruction of the Temple -- none of which Acts mentions. Late dating (~75-85) is the more common critical position. The game presents both.
DesignUse: Present both datings.

Name: Event_GreatFireOfRome_NeronianPersecution
EventTitle: Great Fire of Rome; Neronian Persecution
DesignUse: Hostile-witness corroboration of Christ's execution under Pilate.

Name: Event_PeterPaulMartyred
EventTitle: Peter and Paul Martyred at Rome

Name: Event_JewishWar_TempleDestroyed
EventTitle: Jewish War; AD 70 Destruction of the Temple; Believers Flee to Pella
DesignUse: World-state change. The Jerusalem hub is destroyed.

Name: Event_MarkAlexandrianMission
EventTitle: Mark's Alexandrian Mission
SourceReference: Later Orthodox and Coptic tradition; cf. Eusebius, Hist. eccl. 2.16
DesignUse: Alexandria hub. Attested far more weakly than Mark's Roman Gospel -- the source base is later tradition rather than a near-contemporary like Papias; the Codex system (Task 2) should score its Attestation Strength accordingly lower.

Name: Event_JohnAtEphesus_PatmosExile
EventTitle: John, Last, at Ephesus; Patmos Exile Under Domitian
SourceReference: Clement of Alexandria, via Eusebius, Hist. eccl. 6.14.7; Irenaeus, Adv. Haer. 3.1.1
DesignUse: Final act.

Name: Event_PapiasOfHierapolis
EventTitle: Papias of Hierapolis
SourceReference: Papias, Exposition of the Sayings of the Lord, preserved only in fragments via Eusebius, Hist. eccl. 3.39
DesignUse: Framing device for the whole Codex -- the earliest testimony to Mark and Matthew.

Name: Event_P52RylandsFragment
EventTitle: P52, the Rylands Fragment of John 18
DatingDisputeNote: P52's paleographic dating range has narrowed in more recent scholarship; some argue for a later range within the 2nd century rather than the earliest proposed dates. The 125-175 range given here reflects that genuine spread.
DesignUse: Endgame artifact in Mode A.

Name: Event_IrenaeusAgainstHeresies
EventTitle: Irenaeus, Against Heresies -- The Fourfold Gospel Asserted as Settled
DesignUse: Closing argument.
